```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

    // Newsletter form functionality — Buttondown integration (#13)
    // Uses native form submission as fallback; JS enhances with fetch
    const newsletterForm = document.querySelector('.cli-form');
    if (newsletterForm) {
        newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            const button = this.querySelector('.cli-button');
            const input = this.querySelector('.cli-input');
            const formData = new FormData(this);

            // Try fetch first; if CORS fails, let native form submit handle it
            e.preventDefault();
            button.textContent = '...';
            button.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';

            fetch(this.action, {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
            })
            .then(response => {
                if (response.ok || response.type === 'opaque') {
                    button.textContent = '✓';
                    button.style.background = '#22c55e';
                    button.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                    input.value = 'Subscribed!';
                    input.disabled = true;
                    input.style.color = '#22c55e';
                } else {
                    throw new Error('Submission failed');
                }
            })
            .catch(error => {
                // Fallback: submit form natively
                e.target.submit();
            });
        });
    }

    // Blinking cursor on the ASCII art panel (decorative)
    const asciiArt = document.querySelector('.ascii-art');
    if (asciiArt && !asciiArt.querySelector('.ascii-cursor')) {
        const cursor = document.createElement('span');
        cursor.className = 'ascii-cursor';
        cursor.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        cursor.textContent = '▋';
        cursor.style.color = 'var(--terminal-primary)';
        cursor.style.animation = 'blink 1s infinite';
        cursor.style.marginLeft = '5px';
        asciiArt.appendChild(cursor);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // TERMINAL COLOR THEME SWITCHER
    // ========================================================================
    const themes = ['lavender', 'amber', 'cyan', 'green', 'white'];
    const themeNames = {
        lavender: 'Lavender (Synthwave)',
        amber: 'Amber (IBM 3278)',
        cyan: 'Cyan (VT220)',
        green: 'Green (Matrix)',
        white: 'White (Unix)'
    };

    // Load saved theme or default to lavender
    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('terminal-theme') || 'lavender';
    document.documentElement.dataset.terminalTheme = savedTheme;

    // Mount target: the code-tools button is disabled (code-tools: false), so
    // the switcher mounts into a dedicated slot in the neofetch prompt line,
    // with the title block as a fallback.
    const mountTarget =
        document.querySelector('.theme-switcher-mount') ||
        document.querySelector('.quarto-title-block .quarto-title-meta') ||
        document.querySelector('.quarto-title-block');

    if (mountTarget) {
        const switcher = document.createElement('div');
        switcher.className = 'terminal-theme-switcher';
        switcher.innerHTML = `
            <span class="theme-label">Terminal</span>
            <div class="theme-options">
                ${themes.map(t => `
                    <button class="theme-dot ${t === savedTheme ? 'active' : ''}"
                            data-theme="${t}"
                            title="${themeNames[t]}"
                            aria-label="Switch to ${themeNames[t]} theme"></button>
                `).join('')}
            </div>
        `;

        mountTarget.appendChild(switcher);

        // Add click handlers
        switcher.querySelectorAll('.theme-dot').forEach(dot => {
            dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const theme = dot.dataset.theme;
                document.documentElement.dataset.terminalTheme = theme;
                localStorage.setItem('terminal-theme', theme);

                // Update active states
                switcher.querySelectorAll('.theme-dot').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('active'));
                dot.classList.add('active');
            });
        });
    }
});
</script>
```
